proof_body:
by
  intro a b r x₀ y₀ u v h₀ huv
  have hN : u ^ 2 + v ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    by_cases ha₀ : u = 0
    · have hb₀ : v ≠ 0 := fun hb₀ => huv ⟨ha₀, hb₀⟩
      positivity
    · positivity
  have key : ∀ t : ℝ, (x₀ + t * u - a) ^ 2 + (y₀ + t * v - b) ^ 2 - r ^ 2 = t * (t * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) + 2 * (u * (x₀ - a) + v * (y₀ - b))) := by
    intro t; linear_combination h₀
  constructor
  · intro h
    have ht := h (-(2 * (u * (x₀ - a) + v * (y₀ - b))) / (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)) (by
      have := key (-(2 * (u * (x₀ - a) + v * (y₀ - b))) / (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2))
      have hz : -(2 * (u * (x₀ - a) + v * (y₀ - b))) / (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) + 2 * (u * (x₀ - a) + v * (y₀ - b)) = 0 := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [hz, mul_zero] at this
      linarith)
    rcases div_eq_zero_iff.mp ht with h' | h'
    · linarith
    · exact absurd h' hN
  · intro hS t ht
    have := key t
    rw [hS, ht, sub_self] at this
    have h2 : t ^ 2 * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) = 0 := by linear_combination -this
    have := (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_right hN
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp this
